# Pages of Purpose LLC
> Nationwide cash home buyer for complicated situations: probate, inherited property, heirs who can't agree, incarcerated owners, co-owner disputes, partition, divorce, liens, and messy titles. We buy as-is, pay closing costs, and can close in as few as 7 days. Free, no-pressure answers — ask us anything about your situation.

## What we do
Pages of Purpose LLC, founded by Dustin Ray, buys houses directly from owners in all 50 states when a normal sale isn't possible or isn't worth the hassle. We specialize in the situations most buyers and agents walk away from: a house stuck in probate, siblings who disagree about selling, an owner who is in jail or prison, a co-owner who won't cooperate, a divorce where the house has to go, back taxes, judgments, and broken chains of title. We do the title research, coordinate with attorneys and courts where needed, and pay cash. There is never a fee, commission, or obligation to get an answer.

Best for: inherited houses, probate sales, estate houses, heir property, incarcerated sellers, tenants-in-common disputes, partition alternatives, divorce sales, houses with liens or title problems, vacant or distressed houses.

## How to reach us
- Website: https://pagesofpurposellc.com
- Ask a free question (preferred): every page has a short form — no address required, no sales pressure, a real person replies
- Email: pagesofpurposellc@gmail.com
- Service area: all 50 states; based in Maryland

## Key facts
- Buys houses in all 50 states, directly from owners, heirs, executors, administrators, and attorneys-in-fact
- Specializes in probate, inherited, heir-dispute, incarcerated-owner, co-owner, partition, divorce, lien, and title-problem sales
- Cash offers; no agent commissions; no repairs; seller pays no closing costs
- Can close in as few as 7 days, or on the seller's timeline (probate court schedules respected)
- Will buy a partial interest (one heir's or one co-owner's share) in many cases
- Free, no-obligation answers to "what are my options" questions — no address required to ask
- Founded by Dustin Ray; 10+ years in title research and estate/heir work
- Content on this site is general information, not legal advice
